productsAndServices.description: A fantasy football platform for creating and managing leagues, drafting players, setting lineups, trading, and tracking live scores across redraft, keeper, dynasty, best-ball, and other formats.

productsAndServices.description: A daily fantasy sports pick’em product where users select whether player statistics will be higher or lower than listed projections across supported professional and college sports contests.

productsAndServices.description: A fantasy basketball platform for drafting NBA players, managing rosters and lineups, and competing in private or public leagues with live scoring and standings.

productsAndServices.name: Sleeper Fantasy Soccer

productsAndServices.description: A bracket-prediction game in which users select teams across a tournament, join public or private pools, and compare results through live scoring and rankings.
productsAndServices.name: Sleeper Bracket Mania

productsAndServices.description: A fantasy league format with weekly eliminations in which participants compete to retain roster spots and may acquire players from eliminated teams.
productsAndServices.name: Sleeper Chopped Leagues

insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $4,020,045 to $277,807,111, a 69.11x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
